The name Jawairiyya carries the meaning “Name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawairiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody name of a companion of prophet muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
